```regex
^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$
```

- `^` — Start of the string
- `\d{5}` — Exactly five digits (the base ZIP code)
- `(-\d{4})?` — An optional group that matches a hyphen followed by four digits (the ZIP+4 extension)
- `$` — End of the string

### Examples that match:
- `12345` ✅ (basic ZIP)
- `12345-6789` ✅ (ZIP+4)

- `1234` ❌ (too short)
- `12345-67` ❌ (only 3 digits in extension)

- `abc123` ❌ (non-digit characters)
